overview: Marketing website for Sri Gurusamy Matches Unit — a safety matches manufacturer based in Sivakasi, India, operating since 2007. Features a stunning scroll-driven match lighting animation, product showcase, company story, and contact section.
features: Product showcase with safety matches, wax matches, and dipped splints
Company story with 2007 founding and export capabilities
Contact section with clickable phone numbers and email
Contact form for dealer and customer inquiries
